purpose: Event-local input for combat factors plus actual weapon/platform declarations, including ahistorical or divergent systems.

weapon_systems.platform_class: one of WEAPON_PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_INDEX platform class ids
weapon_systems.historical_relation: HISTORICAL_BASELINE | DIVERGENT_VARIANT | AHISTORICAL_TIMING | AHISTORICAL_NEW | COMPOSITE_DOCTRINAL_SYSTEM | UNKNOWN
weapon_systems.capability_record: required structured value for unindexed novel/divergent/unknown system

rule: A factor under factors counts as event-runtime input. weapon_systems declares actual event-local systems/variants. Unindexed AHISTORICAL_NEW/DIVERGENT_VARIANT/AHISTORICAL_TIMING/UNKNOWN systems require capability_record, availability_or_readiness and source; absence is not neutral.
